title: ATLAS AGENA ROCKET DEPRESSURIZES ON PAD, COLLAPSES AND TEARS ITSELF TO PIECES
summary: A one-minute clip of an Atlas Agena rocket losing pressure on the pad and collapsing. The Atlas relied on tank pressurization for structural integrity, so a simple failure tore it apart.
why: Commenters cite it as vivid proof that pressure-stabilized rocket tanks can fail catastrophically when pressure is lost.

quote.text: a couple Atlas rockets did crumble under their own weight due to unexpected loss of pressure
